name: blockify-desktop
description: A community-maintained Electron shell for Spotify Web with local media filtering.

scripts.verify: npm run build:preload && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.pack: npm run verify && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run verify && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --publish never
